title: itemtextframe
summary: MSUI implements current Benilla's GUID-keyed ItemTextFrame reader with a dedicated positioning/geometry law: readable bag letters share the item-text body cache and resolve the instance creator name, item-template books and type-9 world plaques use PageText/PageMaterial data and the page cache, re-click toggles the same object closed, and page navigation retains a visited trail. The law-seated 384x512 renderer uses the exact mixed ItemText/Spellbook shell, Morpheus ItemTextFontNormal body, material corner art and ink tables, title/From line, scroll clipping, current-page chrome, Prev/Next/Close controls, and reference sound cues. Current Benilla explicitly uses no CMSG_READ_ITEM or gameobject-use packet for these local open routes.

openItems.text: No bag-letter read route: an inventory item with ITEM_FIELD_ITEM_TEXT_ID shows the read hover cursor (InventoryUiLaw.HoverCursor) but right-click never opens the reader; Benilla opens the ItemTextFrame with the mail item-text cache
openItems.resolution: Inventory context handling now routes ITEM_FIELD_ITEM_TEXT_ID ahead of gift/quest/loot/use handling into the shared local reader and obtains its single body through the existing CMSG_ITEM_TEXT_QUERY cache with mail id zero.

openItems.text: No title FontString (item/object name) or creator 'From,' line
openItems.resolution: The reader displays the item or gameobject template name in GameFontNormal and appends the exact signed letter suffix `From,` plus the asynchronously resolved ITEM_FIELD_CREATOR player name.

openItems.text: No page navigation: MSUI concatenates all fetched pages into one view instead of Prev/Next buttons + current-page number
openItems.resolution: Books and plaques retain a visited page-id trail, render only the current cached page, expose current-page/Prev/Next chrome under the reference visibility rules, reset scrolling on page changes, and query missing next pages through CMSG_PAGE_TEXT_QUERY.

openItems.text: No material variants (Stone/Marble/Bronze corner textures, material text/title color tables) - parchment-only
openItems.resolution: PageTextMaterial.dbc is loaded by id; non-parchment pages draw the four exact material corner textures and apply the reference Stone/Marble/Silver/Bronze body/title color tables while parchment leaves the base shell visible.

openItems.text: CMSG_READ_ITEM / SMSG_READ_ITEM_OK multi-page book flow absent (matches registry; also a named follow-up in Benilla)
openItems.resolution: Adjudicated against current Benilla: the historical CMSG_READ_ITEM assumption is retired. Bag books open locally from item-template PageText/PageMaterial, bag letters open locally from instance text/creator fields, and type-9 gameobjects open locally from template Data[0]/Data[2], with only the applicable content query sent.

openItems.text: No open/close sounds (igMainMenuOpen/Close) and no ITEM_TEXT_TRANSLATION progress bar (the latter never fires in Benilla either)
openItems.resolution: Reader show/hide and page turns emit the exact igMainMenuOpen, igMainMenuClose, and igMainMenuOptionCheckBoxOn cues. ITEM_TEXT_TRANSLATION remains intentionally absent because current Benilla documents that it never fires for supported readable content.

openItems.text: Body text is drawn with the default ImGui font at a rough line-wrap estimate, not the ItemTextFontNormal (Morpheus 15) that FontObjectLaw already defines
openItems.resolution: The clipped and scrollable page body is now rendered through the baked ItemTextFontNormal FrameXML font object (Morpheus 15) after SimpleHTML-to-visible-text adaptation, replacing the raw default ImGui text path.
